description: Source code for battery measurement and management on an nRF board using Zephyr RTOS, including ADC setup, GPIO control, and battery level calculation.

methods.name: divider_setup
methods.description: Configures ADC and GPIO for battery voltage measurement.

methods.name: battery_setup
methods.description: Initializes battery measurement system during system startup.

methods.name: battery_measure_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables battery measurement circuitry.

methods.name: battery_sample
methods.description: Samples the battery voltage and computes battery level.

methods.name: battery_level_pptt
methods.description: Converts battery millivolt reading to a level percentage based on a curve.
